en: While the water falls, go to Mama's mirror in Aunt's workshop

speaker: ui
prev: tikhon: Нина. Совсем седая.
ru: Струбцину — на мамино зеркало; смотреть на ходики и сверить с карманными часами
en: Use the clamp on Mama's mirror; watch the wall clock and compare it with my pocket watch

speaker: agata

en: I'll take the rope off the clamp and row it to the pier now. Wait; I won't be long.

speaker: narrator
prev: pelageya: Теперь канат со стопора сниму да лодкой до опоры доплыву. Жди, я мигом.

en: Pelageya returns to her pier and takes the rope off the clamp. She rows to the bridge pier and passes up the rope's end to the ring on the plate.
